title: Your Index Fund Owns And Votes Corporate America
hook: The shares in your account quietly hand voting power to fund giants.
closing: Your index fund gives you ownership, but its manager often casts the vote.
question: Who votes your shares?

segments.say: Index funds hold 52 percent of US stock assets, making passive funds the market's majority owner.
BlackRock, Vanguard and State Street own 22 percent of a typical big company, concentrating that ownership.
Vanguard casts 9 percent of votes at big-company meetings, turning fund ownership into corporate influence.
